answer: No identity stands as an island: each must recruit five recovery guardians from five separate established clusters, each guardian may serve at most three identities, and all five must co-sign a fresh crystal nonce monthly along a public thread in the ledger. Building 1,000 Sybils needs 5,000 distinct guardian slots, forcing the purchase of trust from hundreds of unrelated clusters at about $20 per guardian monthly ($100,000 monthly), plus a 6-coin bond lost when a guardian exceeds the cap or misses a signing.
